# HermesRuns

> HermesRuns is running analytics you can check: a browser app that turns your runs into a daily run, workout or rest call, with its formulas published.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://hermesruns.com/): Running analytics with a daily training call, VO2max estimates, training pace zones, race predictions, route heatmaps, and shoe mileage tracking.
- [Terms of Service](https://hermesruns.com/terms): Terms for using HermesRuns, connected activity imports, training insights, and account features.
- [Privacy Policy](https://hermesruns.com/privacy): How HermesRuns handles account details, connected activity data, training metrics, retention, and privacy choices.

## Product facts

- Runs come from Strava, synced automatically once connected, or from GPX, FIT, and TCX file imports.
- Scores name the inputs they were worked out from, and the formulas are published.
- HermesRuns is informational training support, not medical advice or emergency guidance.
